feature_name: BigQuery ML text embedding generation with ML.GENERATE_EMBEDDING
summary: BigQuery ML can generate text embeddings for text stored in BigQuery by using ML.GENERATE_EMBEDDING with remote models.
extended_definition: BigQuery ML can generate text embeddings for text stored in BigQuery by using ML.GENERATE_EMBEDDING with remote models.

supporting_pages.title: The ML.GENERATE_EMBEDDING function | BigQuery | Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: Function processing Depending on the task, the ML.GENERATE_EMBEDDING function works in one of the following ways: To generate embeddings from text or visual content, ML.GENERATE_EMBEDDING sends the request to a BigQuery ML remote model that represents a Vertex AI embedding model or a supported open model , and then returns the model's response.

Function processing Depending on the task, the AI.GENERATE_EMBEDDING function works in one of the following ways: To generate embeddings from text or visual content, AI.GENERATE_EMBEDDING sends the request to a BigQuery ML remote model that represents a Vertex AI embedding model or a supported open model , and then returns the model's response.

GENERATE_EMBEDDING ( MODEL ` mydataset . text_embedding ` , ( SELECT "Example text to embed" AS content ) ); The result is similar to the following: +-----------------------+-------------------------------------+--------+-----------------------+ | embedding | statistics | status | content | +-----------------------+-------------------------------------+--------+-----------------------+ | -0.097711019217967987 | {"token_count":4,"truncated":false} | | Example text to embed | | 0.014618906192481518 | | | | | ... | | | | +-----------------------+-------------------------------------+--------+-----------------------+ Multimodal embedding This example shows how to generate embeddings from visual content by using a remote model that references a multimodalembedding model.

supporting_pages.title: "Generate text embeddings by using an open model and the AI.GENERATE_EMBEDDING\
evidence_snippets: Generate text embeddings by using an open model and the AI.GENERATE EMBEDDING function This tutorial shows you how to create a remote model that's based on the open-source text embedding model Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B , and then how to use that model with the AI.GENERATE EMBEDDING function to embed movie reviews from the bigquery-public-data.imdb.reviews public table.

GENERATE EMBEDDING ( MODEL bqml tutorial . qwen3 embedding model , ( SELECT review AS content , FROM bigquery - public - data . imdb . reviews LIMIT 5 ) ); The results include the following columns: embedding : an array of double to represent the generated embeddings. status : the API response status for the corresponding row.
Perform text embedding Perform text embedding on IMDB movie reviews by using the remote model and the AI.GENERATE EMBEDDING function: In the Google Cloud console, go to the BigQuery page.
